name: Town of Luang Prabang
description: Luang Prabang is a small royal town in north-central Laos, set on a peninsula where the Mekong meets the Nam Khan River. Gilded Buddhist temples stand beside French colonial villas along its quiet streets, and its name refers to the sacred Phra Bang Buddha image. At dawn, saffron-robed monks still walk the streets to collect alms from kneeling residents.
